summaries.summary: Hundreds have been detained during an anti-CEC protest in Delhi, with leaders of the so-called 'Cockroach' group among those taken into custody. This has sparked political tensions, with the BJP critiquing the opposition's actions and the Supreme Court stepping in to address contempt pleas related to the metro shutdown.

Apple is hosting a surprise Smart Home event next week, expected to unveil new devices including a smart lock, thermostat, and doorbell. Additionally, there are notable developments in AI agents capable of functioning within text messaging platforms. Furthermore, Cloudflare has acquired Deno, aiming to enhance its Workers programming model.

Petra Power is focusing on modernizing energy solutions for data centers and defense vehicles, claiming to offer innovative fuel cell technology. Amazon has reshuffled its Alexa leadership while launching new high-end tablets, indicating a strategic pivot in its device portfolio.

A blast at Riyadh airport has left multiple people wounded, drawing international concern. In Israel, a plot for a suicide attack by a Flydubai co-pilot has been revealed, linked to the events of September 11.

The Delhi Riots case saw a conviction of former AAP councilor Tahir Hussain for abetment, with 12 others acquitted of charges. Furthermore, a contempt plea has been filed in the Supreme Court regarding arbitrary metro station closures and detentions during protests.
A new discussion highlights the effects of psychedelics on brain transformation, exploring their potential in shifting consciousness and perceptions.
